thread:
maria: Hey team — dropping the consolidated company priority slate for the coming quarter. Need quick alignment on scope and launch acceptance criteria so we can hand the deck to GTM by EOD Friday.

maria: High-level commitments: 1) 30% reduction in inference p99 for hosted API, 2) Dedicated GA for reserved capacity contracts, 3) baseline privacy SOC controls for Private deployments.

alex: Quick q — is the 30% p99 target global or for 95th percents on heavy-tail customers?

maria: Global target, but we’ll measure per-customer and tier. Should call out a baseline: p99 on median workload distribution.

kevin: For Dedicated GA, do we plan to ship region parity or just single-region launch? That changes infra scope a lot.

maria: Start with NA + EU as GA. APAC will be beta.

kevin: OK noted. That means we need +2 infra hires or reprioritize autoscaling work.

sarah: Can we be explicit about success metrics for Dedicated? Suggested: 99.9% availability at committed throughput, and no more than 5% cold-start penalty vs hosted.

maria: yes — add those two. Also add latency SLOs per-model class.

jess: Customer asks: Alpha customers want model pinning and snapshot restores. Are those in scope for GA or follow-up?

maria: Pinning = must-have for GA. Snapshot restore = stretch, but include an MVP tech spec linked in the doc.

tim: We should include rollout/fallback policy in acceptance criteria: canary + automatic fallback to smaller model variant when latency > threshold. Ops needs a runbook.

maria: Good call. Add: automated fallback, canary at 5% then 25% then 100%, and rollback criteria.

alex: One more ask — Redwood Optimize improvements (quantization recommendations) are a customer differentiator. Do we include a lightweight v1 in the quarter?

maria: Include Optimize v1: automated quantization suggestions + cost delta report for top 10 models. Not the full auto-apply flow.

olivia: From security — Private deployment baseline needs KMS integration and audit export. Can we commit to KMS in GA?

maria: Yes, KMS integration required for GA. Audit export is stretch but must have auditing hooks.

planning-bot: Reminder: draft must be in the shared drive by 12:00pm Wed for exec review.

kevin: Impacts to eng-schedule: autoscaling refactor moves from Q3 -> Q4 if we keep current hires. Need to prioritise or we delay latency target.

maria: Tradeoff decision: prioritize autoscaling + serving runtime kernels to hit p99 target. Defer non-critical telemetry revamp.

jess: Customer-facing launch criteria suggestion: include a short matrix stating who gets Dedicated first (top-tier customers + security-sensitive customers). Helps sales.

maria: Agree. Add a launch audience matrix in the doc.

olivia: One API compatibility question — are there any breaking changes in API for GA? We should avoid breaking surface for hosted customers.

maria: No breaking API changes. Any internal routing flags behind the scenes only.

sarah: For acceptance tests, suggest these must pass before sign-off: (a) 1 week of synthetic load hitting p99 target, (b) canary rollback test exercise, (c) KMS key rotate test.

maria: Add those. Also add a customer pilot cohort of 3 by launch.

alex: I’ll update the metric baselines in the doc and include historical p99 curves.

maria: Thanks. Final ask — if there are no major objections by Thu 4pm I'll lock the slate and request exec sign-off. Please drop any redlines ASAP. :thumbsup:

jess: No blockers from PMM. :white_check_mark:

tim: Ops aligned, will prep runbooks.

kevin: Eng can hit it if we get two contractors approved for kernel work.

olivia: Security approves the scope contingent on KMS delivery.

sarah: Sign-off from SRE pending on canary run success — will run next Tue.

maria: Great — locking action items: alex -> metrics, kevin -> infra hiring ask, tim -> runbooks, jess -> launch matrix, olivia -> KMS plan, sarah -> canary test. I'll update doc and ping execs after Thu 4pm.

maria: Thanks everyone — much faster than I expected.
